title: MetricMine table contract proposal
description: Structured-outputs schema for the bottom-up proposer stances (D-21 as amended, D-34): stance describe turns an existing table's own profile into an ODCS table contract that would enforce it; stance amend turns that profile plus the committed contract into a version-bumped proposal with an explicit changes list. The harness renders a proposal to an ODCS contract mirroring silver v1.1.0; datacontract lint and the deterministic validator gate it. Flat by construction: no oneOf, no conditionals, every property required, arrays may be empty.

stance.description: describe: the profile is the sole input and changes is empty. amend: the profile plus the committed contract are the input and changes lists every difference.

target_schema.description: Warehouse schema holding the described table; rendered as the server schema and used to qualify quality-rule SQL.

target_table.description: Exact table name from the profile's dataset.table, snake_case.

proposed_version.description: Semver for the proposed contract. describe: 1.0.0 when no contract exists. amend: the committed version with the bump the changes justify (patch for description only, minor for additive, major for breaking).

columns.description: One entry per column the contract declares, in profile ordinal order.

name.description: Exact column name from the profile.

physical_type.description: Physical type exactly as the profile reports it, e.g. VARCHAR, INTEGER, DECIMAL(10,2), TIMESTAMP, BOOLEAN, DATE.

required.description: true only when the profile shows null_rate 0.0 for this column; a nonzero null rate forces false.

description.description: Business meaning of the column, one or two sentences, for the rendered contract.

rationale.description: One sentence citing profile evidence (null_rate, distinct_count, min, max, samples) for the type and the required flag.

grain_keys.description: Column names forming the declared grain, in key order; rendered as primaryKey flags with primaryKeyPosition and as the error-severity grain_unique rule. Empty only when the table has no declarable grain.

quality_rules.description: Quality rules the contract enforces. Keep the set small and mechanically renderable; anything richer is a human edit after approval.

kind.description: row_count_positive and grain_unique are table-level; not_null, non_negative, and accepted_values_subset are column-level.

column.description: Column the rule applies to; the empty string for a table-level rule (row_count_positive, grain_unique).

values.description: Allowed values for accepted_values_subset, taken verbatim from the profile's distinct_values; the empty array for every other kind.

rationale.description: One sentence citing profile evidence for the rule.

changes.description: Stance amend only: one entry per difference from the committed contract, including every column the committed contract declares that this proposal drops. Empty array for stance describe.

column.description: Column the change touches; the empty string for a table-level change (grain_change, rule_change, no_change).

before.description: Committed value as a short string; the empty string for add_column.

after.description: Proposed value as a short string; the empty string for drop_column.

rationale.description: One sentence citing profile evidence for the change.

decisions.description: Rendered as customProperties decision* keys, the convention silver v1.1.0 established.

key.description: customProperties key, camelCase, starting with decision.

value.description: Short kebab-case value recorded in the contract.

rationale.description: One sentence justifying the decision from profile evidence.

purpose.description: description.purpose in the rendered contract: what the table is.

usage.description: description.usage in the rendered contract: how a consumer reads it and what they must handle.

limitations.description: description.limitations in the rendered contract: what the table does not guarantee, stated from profile evidence.
